headline: Volvo Cars Plunges After Q3 Loss, Doubled Cash Burn and Job Cuts
summary: Volvo Cars shares fell a record 24 percent after the automaker reported a larger-than-expected third-quarter operating loss, doubled its cash burn, and announced 2,500 job cuts.
why: Major automotive manufacturers are key bellwethers for consumer discretionary demand, industrial supply chains, and employment trends.

impacts.name: Volvo Cars
impacts.why: Wacker operating losses, increased cash burn, and workforce reductions directly harm equity valuations.

why_moved: Worse-than-expected financial results and restructuring announcements signal severe operational headwinds, triggering aggressive selling by investors.
